title: Round distances half up in rides/view_model.py:4-6
description: Phase 1 implementation. Serves design.md criterion: 2.25 km displays as 2.3 km; and the risk mitigation 'convert through Decimal before rounding'. Test first in tests/test_view_model.py: change line 9 expectation format_distance(12.25) from '12.2 km' to '12.3 km'; add format_distance(2.25) == '2.3 km', format_distance(1.15) == '1.2 km' (fails if the float goes to Decimal directly), format_distance(10.0) == '10.0 km'. Then replace round with Decimal(str(km)).quantize(Decimal('0.1'), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP), keeping an isinstance(km, int) branch so format_distance(5) stays '5 km'; no normalize(). Done when tests/test_view_model.py and python3 -m pytest -q are green. See tasks.md Phase 1, Changes Required #2.
close_reason: Implemented half-up distance rounding, tests passing
